candidates.computation_change_reason: The December 2015 amendment date and the 'Standard Conditions' designation bear on which permit version and default condition set govern FY2025 applicability; the 'Page 1 of Part III' label conflicts with the segment locator 'part_i', so resolving which Part's MQL table applies changes which numeric thresholds and monitoring conditions are in scope.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes that the listed values are MQLs in µg/l rather than effluent discharge limits; interpreting them as enforceable limits versus report-only quantitation thresholds changes whether FY2025 measurements undergo numeric exceedance comparison and how sub-MQL or non-detect results are classified.

Groups listed pollutants under a base/neutral fraction category; whether a reported parameter or sample type falls in this category versus another fraction determines which MQL row applies and whether monitoring for that fraction was required.

Separately categorizes pesticide and PCB parameters with distinct MQL values; applicability of limits and monitoring obligations for a given analyte depends on whether it is treated as a pesticide/PCB under this table rather than a base/neutral pollutant.

The revision date anchors which edition of the MQL schedule is operative; a different effective or superseding revision date would change the numeric MQL values used for FY2025 limit comparisons and monitoring expectations.

Assigns a 50 µg/l MQL to Benzidine, substantially higher than the 5–10 µg/l values for many co-listed analytes; the applicable MQL controls numeric comparison and whether a reported or non-detect result is treated as quantified, below quantitation, or missing evidence.

Sets a 50 µg/l MQL for n-Nitrosodimethylamine; interpreting this value differently or matching it to the wrong parameter row would change exceedance determinations and the evidentiary status of low-level or non-detect results.

Provides a low pesticide MQL (0.01 µg/l) for Aldrin within the Pesticides and PCBs block; whether this row governs a given measurement affects numeric comparison outcomes and how results near or below quantitation are categorized.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Mercury is not listed in the table body but is governed by a conditional footnote: default MQL 0.005 µg/l versus 0.0005 µg/l when Part I requires Method 1631. Resolving whether Part I imposes Method 1631 changes the applicable numeric threshold, whether that monitoring method was required, and how mercury non-detects or low-level results are interpreted for missing-evidence purposes.
